-	Spa Head greeted guest and extend sincere apology for treatment delay.
-	Due to guest do not want to talk more, Spa Head will offer courtesy call to guest tomorrow.
-	Informed GRO team must inform guest treatment start time no matter guest will use Spa facility or not.

charts.explanation: Status composition for VIP incidents only.

charts.explanation: VIP incident status split across top 10 departments.

charts.formula: TOP 10 Incident Category BY COUNT(Incident Case)

charts.explanation: Heatmap of incident concentration by hotel and top departments.
charts.formula: X=Hotel, Y=Top Departments, Value=COUNT(Incident Case)

charts.explanation: VIP status share with drilldown to department within each VIP status.

charts.name: Incidents by Top 10 Category (Drilldown)

charts.name: Incident Volume vs Closure Rate Trend
charts.explanation: Dual-axis trend of incident volume and closure rate.

charts.name: Status Mix
charts.explanation: Operational state composition of completed, pending, and cancelled cases.

charts.name: Incident Heat Over Time by Hour
